# forumulate_status_page (Data Source)

The current state of a public status page.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "forumulate_status_page" "page" {
  space_id = var.status_space_id
}

# Refuse to roll out while the page reports an outage.
output "page_is_up" {
  value = data.forumulate_status_page.page.overall == "up"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `space_id` (String)

### Read-Only

- `active_count` (Number) Open incidents and maintenance under way.
- `description` (String) The page's headline, in the owner's words.
- `indicator` (String) Statuspage's word: `none`, `minor`, `major`, `critical` or `maintenance`.
- `name` (String)
- `overall` (String) `up`, `degraded`, `maintenance`, `down` or `unknown`.
- `url` (String)
